name: Plate XIX: The Orphic Egg
description: The cosmic egg of the Orphics with the serpent of creation coiled about it, from which Phanes, the first-born light, broke forth. Struck in Lapis Lazuli: ground lapis, the stone of the night sky and of Egyptian heaven. Degree of Initiate, rank 192 of the folio. “ΕΝ ΤΟ ΠΑΝ”: One is the All.
